# GIFT City Funds

> Plain-English educational guide to GIFT City (IFSC) mutual funds, AIFs and PMS structures for NRIs, OCIs and resident Indians. Written by Anup Vatyani, AMFI-registered Mutual Fund Distributor (ARN 106715). Informational only; not investment, tax or legal advice.

## Guides

- [What Is GIFT City & IFSC?](https://giftcityfunds.in/what-is-gift-city): India's international financial services centre and its regulator, IFSCA.
- [GIFT City Fund Categories](https://giftcityfunds.in/funds-explained): Mutual Fund FoFs, AIFs, PMS and feeder funds compared.
- [Who GIFT City Funds Are For](https://giftcityfunds.in/who-its-for): Fit for NRIs, OCIs and resident Indians.
- [Regulation and Taxation](https://giftcityfunds.in/taxation): IFSCA oversight, Section 10(4D), LRS and TCS.
- [How to Invest in GIFT City Funds](https://giftcityfunds.in/how-to-invest): Step-by-step for NRIs and residents: structures, LRS vs direct USD, KYC document checklist, remittance, allotment, redemption.
- [GIFT City Funds vs Regular Mutual Funds](https://giftcityfunds.in/gift-city-funds-vs-mutual-funds): Regulator, currency, minimums, eligibility and tax compared.
- [Risks of GIFT City Funds](https://giftcityfunds.in/gift-city-funds-risks): Market, currency, liquidity, tax and regulatory risks.
- [GIFT City Insurance for NRIs](https://giftcityfunds.in/gift-city-insurance): US Dollar life and term policies from IFSC insurance offices, IFSCA regulation, the Section 10(10D) change from 1 April 2025, and tax abroad.
- [GIFT City Bonds](https://giftcityfunds.in/gift-city-bonds): USD, masala and green bonds on India INX and NSE IX; USD 70.31 billion cumulative listings by 31 March 2026; who can buy.
- [Redemption and Repatriation](https://giftcityfunds.in/gift-city-redemption-repatriation): How to withdraw from a GIFT City fund, timelines, where proceeds go, and the 180-day rule for residents.
- [Moving Country with GIFT City Investments](https://giftcityfunds.in/gift-city-moving-country): Returning to India (FEMA 6(4), RNOR), moving abroad, moving between countries, PFIC and exit taxes.
- [GIFT City Rule Changes](https://giftcityfunds.in/gift-city-rules-updates): Dated log of IFSCA, RBI, SEBI and tax changes that affect investors, reviewed monthly.
- [GIFT City Document Checklist](https://giftcityfunds.in/gift-city-document-checklist): Interactive KYC checklist by status (NRI, OCI, resident), country and product.
- [GIFT City Funds Returns and Performance](https://giftcityfunds.in/gift-city-funds-returns): Where to find NAVs and factsheets, how the rupee and fees change returns, and how to review a fund fairly. No rankings.
- [Zerodha, Groww and GIFT City](https://giftcityfunds.in/gift-city-funds-zerodha-groww): IFSCA approvals of June 2026 for Zerodha, Upstox, Groww and Angel One (US stocks and ETFs), and how GIFT City funds are bought instead.
- [GIFT City News](https://giftcityfunds.in/gift-city-news): Dated, sourced GIFT City news for investors: new funds, IFSCA decisions, banking and market updates.
- [FAQs](https://giftcityfunds.in/faqs): Short answers to common questions.
- [GIFT City Fund List 2026](https://giftcityfunds.in/gift-city-fund-list): Every public GIFT City fund we could verify, from 20 fund houses (PPFAS, HDFC, DSP, JioBlackRock, Edelweiss, Tata and more): minimum, who can invest (residents or NRIs), inbound or outbound, with sources. Facts only, not ranked.

- [What Is IFSCA?](https://giftcityfunds.in/what-is-ifsca): The unified regulator for GIFT IFSC, set up on 27 April 2020 under the IFSCA Act, 2019.
- [GIFT City vs Singapore vs Dubai](https://giftcityfunds.in/gift-city-vs-singapore-dubai): The three fund centres compared for Indian and NRI investors.
- [GIFT Nifty and GIFT City Exchanges](https://giftcityfunds.in/gift-city-markets-gift-nifty): GIFT Nifty vs SGX Nifty, trading hours, who can trade, NSE IX, India INX, IIBX.
- [Family Offices, FPIs, VC Funds and Wealth Management](https://giftcityfunds.in/gift-city-family-office-fpi): Family investment funds, IFSC FPIs and SEBI's 2024 NRI change, venture capital schemes, PMS.
- [Banks in GIFT City and Business Setup](https://giftcityfunds.in/gift-city-banks-and-business-setup): IFSC Banking Units, foreign currency accounts, company setup, SEZ vs DTA, leasing.
- [GIFT City Guide](https://giftcityfunds.in/gift-city-guide): Ownership, area, location, metro, liquor rules, jobs and property.
- [GIFT City AIF](https://giftcityfunds.in/gift-city-aif): Restricted and venture capital schemes, USD 150,000 minimum, vs SEBI Category I/II/III.
- [GIFT City PMS](https://giftcityfunds.in/gift-city-pms): USD 75,000 minimum, discretionary vs non-discretionary, vs domestic PMS.
- [GIFT City Feeder Funds](https://giftcityfunds.in/gift-city-feeder-funds): Inbound and outbound feeders; feeder vs direct FPI.
- [GIFT City Minimum Investment and Limits](https://giftcityfunds.in/gift-city-minimum-investment): Every minimum, LRS limit and TCS threshold in one table.
- [GIFT City Funds for NRIs](https://giftcityfunds.in/gift-city-funds-for-nri): Complete NRI guide with full explanations for the UAE, Gulf, UK, US (PFIC, QEF, mark-to-market), Canada, Singapore and Australia; minimums from USD 500.
- [GIFT City Funds for UAE NRIs](https://giftcityfunds.in/gift-city-funds-for-uae-nris): Investing from Dubai or Abu Dhabi: no UAE personal tax, TRC, India's deemed-resident rule, funds that accept UAE residents.
- [GIFT City Funds for Gulf NRIs](https://giftcityfunds.in/gift-city-funds-for-gulf-nris): Saudi Arabia, Qatar, Kuwait, Bahrain and Oman: local tax country by country, Oman's 5% income tax from 2028, deemed-resident rule, documents (Iqama, QID, Civil ID, CPR).
- [GIFT City Funds for UK NRIs](https://giftcityfunds.in/gift-city-funds-for-uk-nris): UK offshore fund rules, reporting fund status, CGT rates and the 4-year FIG regime.
- [GIFT City Funds for US NRIs](https://giftcityfunds.in/gift-city-funds-for-us-nris): Funds that exclude US persons, PFIC and Form 8621, QEF and mark-to-market, FBAR and Form 8938.
- [GIFT City Funds for Singapore NRIs](https://giftcityfunds.in/gift-city-funds-for-singapore-nris): No capital gains tax, foreign-sourced income for individuals, Certificate of Residence, currency risk.
- [GIFT City Funds for Canada NRIs](https://giftcityfunds.in/gift-city-funds-for-canada-nris): Funds that exclude Canadian residents, 50% capital gains inclusion, T1135 and section 94.1.
- [How to Invest Abroad from India](https://giftcityfunds.in/invest-abroad-from-india): Four routes for residents compared: international mutual funds and the SEBI cap, India-listed global ETFs, US stocks under LRS, GIFT City funds.
- [GIFT City Funds for OCIs](https://giftcityfunds.in/gift-city-funds-for-oci): OCI eligibility, documents and citizenship rules.
- [GIFT City Funds for Resident Indians](https://giftcityfunds.in/gift-city-funds-for-resident-indians): LRS, TCS, what residents can and cannot do, Schedule FA.
- [GIFT City Glossary](https://giftcityfunds.in/gift-city-glossary): 27 terms (IFSC, FME, LRS, TCS, PFIC, inbound/outbound) defined.

## Tools

- [TCS calculator for GIFT City investments](https://giftcityfunds.in/insights/lrs-tcs-gift-city#calculator): 20% TCS on LRS remittances above ₹10 lakh a year (FY 2026-27), with a calculator.
- [GIFT City Route Checker](https://giftcityfunds.in/gift-city-route-checker): Four questions to see whether LRS, direct USD, NRE or NRO rules apply, and PFIC for US persons.

## Insights articles

- [How to Open a GIFT City Bank Account (IFSC Banking Unit)](https://giftcityfunds.in/insights/how-to-open-gift-city-bank-account): Who can open one, documents, funding and what to compare.
- [GIFT City Fixed Deposits vs NRE and FCNR Deposits](https://giftcityfunds.in/insights/gift-city-fd-vs-nre-fcnr): Currency, tenure, Indian tax on interest and returning to India.
- [Returning to India? What Happens to Your GIFT City Investments](https://giftcityfunds.in/insights/returning-to-india-gift-city-investments): RNOR status, FEMA holdings rules, LRS for new money, checklist.
- [LRS and TCS for GIFT City Funds](https://giftcityfunds.in/insights/lrs-tcs-gift-city): USD 250,000 LRS limit, no TCS up to ₹10 lakh, 20% above, claiming it back, calculator.
- [AIF vs PMS vs Mutual Fund FoF: Choosing a GIFT City Structure](https://giftcityfunds.in/insights/aif-vs-pms-vs-fof): A side-by-side comparison of the three main GIFT City fund structures — AIF, PMS and Mutual Fund FoF — to help you choose the right one for your ticket size and goals.
- [IFSCA vs SEBI: Who Actually Regulates Your GIFT City Fund](https://giftcityfunds.in/insights/ifsca-vs-sebi): A clear explanation of how IFSCA regulates GIFT City IFSC funds, how that differs from SEBI's role for domestic Indian mutual funds, and what it means for investor protection.
- [GIFT City Fund vs NRE/NRO Investing: A Straight Comparison](https://giftcityfunds.in/insights/gift-city-vs-nre-nro): How investing through a GIFT City fund compares with the traditional NRE and NRO account route for NRIs — currency, repatriation, tax and structure differences explained.
- [GIFT City vs Direct Foreign Investment: What Actually Changes for an NRI](https://giftcityfunds.in/insights/gift-city-vs-direct-foreign): What changes when an NRI invests through a GIFT City IFSC fund instead of investing directly in a foreign brokerage account or offshore fund.
- [Ten Questions NRIs Actually Ask About GIFT City Funds](https://giftcityfunds.in/insights/ten-questions-nris-ask): Ten plain-English answers to the questions NRIs most commonly ask before investing in a GIFT City IFSC fund.
- [PFIC Explained: Why It Matters for Every US-Based NRI Investor](https://giftcityfunds.in/insights/pfic-explained): A plain-English explanation of PFIC status, why it applies to many foreign funds, and why GIFT City fund structure matters for US-based NRIs and US persons.
